message.content: The discussion about binaural tones is initiated by ChaeSong-hwa, who expresses interest in exploring this technique and its potential impact on enhancing the listening experience. ChaeSong-hwa suggests that the team should consider experimenting with binaural tones during their next jam session, which LiHua and YurikoYamamoto both enthusiastically agree to. This indicates that ChaeSong-hwa takes the lead in suggesting and initiating this idea, followed by the support of the other members.
